from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityFacultyData(BaseModel):
    """Part-time instructional faculty data for a single university from one CDS document."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="The name of the university as reported in the document")
    part_time_instructional_faculty_count: int | None = Field(description="The number of part-time instructional faculty members reported")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period the data covers, e.g., Fall 2021")
    c_ds_section: str | None = Field(description="The CDS section identifier where the data is located")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_faculty_data: list[UniversityFacultyData]
